summary.headline: Jupiter–Mars Configurations
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Jupiter–Mars configurations and the opening of Sun–Jupiter configurations, covering conjunctions, sextiles, trines, squares, and oppositions, with effects on kings, cities, religions, merchants, warfare, illness, and servitude.
